author: CreeperReaperX
body:
I have met all the criteria, feel free to check.


Age: 14

Timezone: CST

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes

Do you have Discord? Yes CreeperReaperX#8630

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes



CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?

I am a mod on GriffersMC and The Pact

What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

Probably that I can be too nice. I sometimes fall for apologies but I will try not to let it get in my way.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

A leader needs fairness, honesty, bravery, and they need to be understanding. I would consider myself a leader, as I can put myself in other people's shoes, I wouldn't care if my popularity went down the toilet as long as I did the right thing, and I can always find a way to include people.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I can talk to people and feel what they're feeling, and I know how to show respect.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

I believe you should be able to start a conversation, and keep one going for a decent amount of time. You also need to be respectful of the rest of the community. I believe I have most if not all of these traits.

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

Fairness, bravery, and respect.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

I would inform staff members about it and if nothing gets done within a small time span (say,10-30 minutes) I would have a chat with him. I would record the chat log just in case we need it for further investigation.

You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

I would probably just ask them to keep the conversation a little more respectful. The person on the staff worked hard to get there, and they should be shown some respect even if they're not doing their job too well.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

All I would probably do is ask why it can't be shown to the rest of the players in the team.

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

I would talk to them about what the community feels about them using their permissions like that and try to get them to stop.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


Why do you want to be a moderator?

I feel like there are too many hackers going around on avicus, (check www.avicus.net/punishments) and that we need more staff to stop it.

What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus is probably my favorite server, the one I spend most of my time on. Avicus has a great community and I want to help it by becoming a moderator.

Anything specific the staff team could do better?

The staff is doing pretty well for the most part, but I have been in games where there is a hacker and nobody does anything about it for upward of 20 minutes. I feel like at least a Jr. Mod could come on and mount them.

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

Avicus is probably my favorite server, and believe me, I've been on many. I love the community with all my heart, and want to help stop the hackers so that we can finally be hacker-free.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?

Thank you for taking your time to look over this. I look forward to the results!
